page.overview:
What is Morrtlgh?

Morrtlgh (also known as the Cloud of Knowledge or Devourer of Sons) is a fictional entity created by Anthony Warren for the Miskatonic University Library Association Monograph supplement Kingdom of the Blind, part of a series of fan-driven supplements released by Call of Cthulhu publisher Chaosium.

Morrtlgh is a Great Old One who manifests as a glowing orb which rests at the centre of a swirling vortex of tiny, razor-sharp blades of a metallic appearance. It maintains a small cult of worshippers in rural England, much of its former congregation - located across Western Europe - having disappeared over the ages. Although currently imprisoned, it is still able to manifest itself in a much-diminished form when summoned.

The entity was known to have granted its followers magical boons in the past. To invoke these powers, a sacrifice had to be offered, one which would subsequently be reduced to a fine red mist by Morrtlgh's multitude of spinning blades. It would then use these same blades to inscribe spells upon the living flesh of its supplicants. (: Kingdom of the Blind)

Once free to roam the world and do as it pleased, during the 14th century Morrtlgh was imprisoned beneath a barrow in the English countryside by a coven of white witches. During that time, its power was vastly inhibited, and its worship slowly died out. However, during the 1920s, a team of unwitting scholars, interested in any potential archaeological discoveries which might lie within the barrow, threatened to accidentally set the fearsome creature free. (: Kingdom of the Blind)
